file_impact.reason: New pure helper scoped_selection_ids(selection_ids, typed_mutations) placed beside _scope_excluded (its conceptual home): expands planner selection ids to LOCAL IDS ∪ their BOUND JIRA KEYS from mutation provenance, so a bound-issue outbound update (target=jira_key) scopes in and plans mutate — parity with the legacy _build_filter_target_set. Located here (not run_differs) to respect the 800-LOC module cap.
Wire the single plan_pass call site to scope selection ids through ticket_planner.scoped_selection_ids so the bound-issue update is recognized in-scope and dispatched.

Held-out RED→GREEN oracle: sync --only must dispatch a bound-issue scalar update to the transport write (RED before fix); --filter-local-ids parity guard (GREEN). Spawns a clean subprocess via the repr-safe subprocess_env() boundary.
Clean-subprocess probe driving reconcile_once with an in-memory transport (avoids pytest conftest module-seeding collision).
Pure-function teeth for scoped_selection_ids: scoped expansion, unselected ticket not pulled in, create target unchanged.
